# Draft:Battle of Fates

----
Battle of Fates is a 2026 Korean Reality TV show about 49 competitors with varying talents in shamanism, tarot, face reading and psychic abilities who face off to determine who has the strongest abilities in the clairvoyant space. The clairvoyants have to complete tasks to prove that they have powers. The judging panel is made up on five judges who range from believers to skeptics.
The show is a 10 episode series that ran from Feb 11, 2026 - Mar 4, 2026.
